mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was most worthwhile: its explanation connected circulating seawater, dissolved chemicals and energy on a dark seafloor, opening an intriguing possibility for life.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making a trench felt less rewarding because the result gave little explanation and did not visibly advance either goal.

surprise.text: Earth and water made pigment rather than a mineral-transport intermediate; its connection to the goal was unclear.

arbitrary.text: The pigment combination felt arbitrary in this chapter because its purpose was not explained.

continue.text: Yes. The vent's chemical-energy hint makes me curious about how the world might become living, and the weathering route offered a clear, satisfying sequence.
